chapter: Cab Calloway, Lunceford, Hampton and Armstrong, 1941-45
title: Territory bands, and New York's arrangers
summary: Welburn notes the decline of Kansas City and territory bands; McRae says New York's arrangers like Redman and Mundy set the pace.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
